changelog:
- Major update: streamlined documentation, clarified command usage, and updated workflow and credit costs.
- Documentation now has more concise usage examples and API references.
- Credit usage per second changed: Normal mode is now 3 credits/sec (was 1), HD is 5 credits/sec (was 3).
- Execution flow and required tool info are now presented in step-by-step, exact bash commands.
- Authentication supports both ApiKey and Bearer headers (ApiKey recommended); instructions updated.
- Old documentation files and metadata were removed for clarity and reduced redundancy.
summary: AI Video Enhancement - Upscale video resolution, denoise, sharpen. Supports local files and YouTube/Bilibili URLs. HD/4K upscaling with real-time progress.
